subject: Concierge onboarding + custom integration — approval needed
messages:
From: James Liao <james.liao@crestlinehealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Concierge onboarding + SSO integration included?

Hi Priya,

Quick note from our side — we loved the demo last week. Crestline is evaluating Redwood for two key initiatives: (1) embed a triage/chat assistant across our clinic portals and (2) a reranker for patient messaging.

Two asks that will determine whether we can move forward this quarter:
- Can you include a concierge onboarding package (two-week kickstart with an assigned TAM + runbooks) as part of the initial purchase?
- We need a custom SSO + SCIM integration between Redwood and our identity platform (Okta) — will that be included in the onboarding or billed separately?

Budget: we have an internal target ~ $400k ARR for year one, but procurement will push for bundled pricing if onboarding/integration are included.

Can you outline what you can include and if there are any one-time credits you can offer? We can jump on a 30-min call tomorrow.

Best,
James
Director of Digital Ops
Crestline Health

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: James Liao <james.liao@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@crestlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Concierge onboarding + SSO integration included?

James — thanks for the clear ask and the time last week. Short answer: yes, we can include a concierge onboarding and support the Okta SSO/SCIM integration, but the integration work is typically scoped as a one-time engineering engagement unless we bundle a fixed number of hours into the contract.

Proposed approach:
- Include Premium Support (24/7) for the first 12 months.
- Include a 40-hour engineering credit for the Okta SSO/SCIM integration as part of the onboarding package. Any additional hours billed at standard professional services rates.
- Provide a two-week kickoff with a named TAM, delivery runbook, and a go-live checklist.

I need to escalate two non-standard asks for approval: a 25% discount to meet your budget target, and the 40-hour integration credit. Can I route this to my manager and deal desk for sign-off? If approved, I’ll send an updated SOW and pricing worksheet and a DocuSign link.

Proposed next step: 30-min call tomorrow 2pm PT to confirm scope.

— Priya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Crestline — request for discount + integration credit (exec approval requested)

Team — forwarding Crestline’s ask. Highlights and decision needed:
- ARR: ~ $420k list for year one (proposed base).
- Customer requests 25% discount off list to hit budget constraints.
- Customer requests Premium Support included for 12 months (standard add-on).
- Customer requests a 40-hour engineering credit for Okta SSO/SCIM (non-standard to include in MRR).
- They want the integration completed within 30 days of contract execution and a kickoff within 5 business days.

Attachments: pricing_redlines.xlsx (pricing impact), Crestline_SOW_v3_draft.pdf (SOW with integration tasks).

Impact: 25% discount + 40-hour credit reduces first-year revenue by approx $78k and shifts 40 hours of engineering to Redwood MOP. The deal accelerates an enterprise customer with potential expansion across 120 clinics — high strategic value.

Ask: Exec approval to grant up to 25% discount and include up to 40 hours of integration credit as part of the onboarding bundle. If you prefer a conditional structure (e.g., credit applied after signed renewal), please advise.

I’ll hold the DocuSign until I get sign-off.

Thanks — Priya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_nataranan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-23T13:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Crestline — request for discount + integration credit (exec approval requested)

Priya — thanks for the breakdown and the SOW. I’m supportive of moving the deal forward but want tighter guardrails on the concessions. My decision:

- Approve a 20% one-time discount to list for year one (not the full 25%).
- Approve inclusion of up to 30 hours of engineering credit for the Okta integration (not 40). Any overage billed at PS rates.
- Include Premium Support (12 months) as requested.

Conditions:
1) Customer must sign a 12-month committed term (no month-to-month).
2) Add SLA amendment language that caps emergency on-call response time and escalation routes — hand to Legal for review.
3) One-time integration credit to be reflected in SOW as a line item ("integration credit - 30 hrs") and marked as non-recurring.
4) Finance to review revenue impact; if there’s a larger one-time credit required, we need CFO sign-off.

Ben — can you reissue pricing_redlines.xlsx and an updated SOW reflecting 20% / 30-hour credit and include HubSpot link. Priya — confirm acceptance with the customer and send the DocuSign.

—Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-24T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Crestline — request for discount + integration credit (exec approval requested)

Looping in updated materials. I drafted the revised SOW and pricing sheet per Marissa’s guidance: 20% discount off year-one list, 30-hour integration credit, Premium Support included 12 months. Also added conditional clause: an additional 5% renewal credit if they commit to a multi-year renewal at year-end.

Attachments: Crestline_SOW_v4_draft.pdf, pricing_redlines_v2.xlsx
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/record/CR-2027-0421 (updated)

Notes: finance flagged the one-time revenue impact (~$58k). If legal signs off on SLA amendments, we can proceed to DocuSign. Priya — recommend offering a kickoff date window the week after signature to meet their timeline.

—Ben
Deal Desk Lead

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: James Liao <james.liao@crestlinehealth.com>, Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@crestlinehealth.com>, procurement@crestlinehealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Final terms: Crestline Premium onboarding + Okta integration (DocuSign link)

James/Patricia — thank you for the discussion and patience while we routed approvals. Summary of approved commercial terms (final):
- Year-one list ARR: $420,000
- Customer discount: 20% off year-one list (applied at signature)
- Premium Support: included for 12 months from go-live
- One-time engineering credit: 30 hours for Okta SSO/SCIM integration (additional hours billed at PS rates)
- Conditional renewal incentive: additional 5% credit applied if customer signs a multi-year renewal at the 12-month mark

Attached: Crestline_SOW_v4_for_signature.pdf, pricing_redlines.xlsx
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/example-sign-link

Next steps:
1) Please review and sign the DocuSign envelope.
2) Once signed, we’ll schedule a kickoff meeting (targeting week of 7/5).
3) Delivery team will confirm Okta access and SCIM endpoints during the kickoff.

If this aligns, I’ll send the DocuSign now.

Best,
Priya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Crestline_SOW_v4_for_signature.pdf (SOW, 9 pages), pricing_redlines.xlsx (pricing table)
